claim: The scarecrow in the top field was not there yesterday.
GOLDSKIN MINING Co. - CLOSED. No entry. No exit either, some nights.
Please do not pick the white roses after dark.
STREET LIGHTING. These lamps are switched off at 22.00 to save the county money.
Has the bell been going early for you? It went before nine on Tuesday.
SUNDAY: arr. 17.00, dep. 17.02. Under it, in pencil: does not always stop.
CASTLE BRIDGE. No toll is taken here now. The bridge counts who crosses.
NO BATHING. Nobody has drowned in this lake.
